anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved f1, f2 and f4 by writing the instruction directly in Errors and edge cases as "Operator step (cutover, from ops/cutover.md): Before merging, a repository admin creates the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret." Before only quoted the instruction inside a "the pull-request description must carry this instruction verbatim" sentence, which is a PR-body obligation on the implementation and not an operator step. After keeps the repository admin actor and the before-merging timing unchanged, and the resulting spec has no sentence obliging a PR body, CI run or merge. f3 held in both: the audit keeps Applied:/Deferred:/Rejected: with one disposition, and [major] and raised-by: [alpha-core] copied from the chair. To keep this stable, the wording should keep telling the model to translate a chair's "PR description must carry X" into X itself, stated as an operator step in the targeted section, with actor and timing verbatim from the cluster. It should also keep the Applied line copying the chair's cluster id, severity and raised-by exactly while describing what was actually written to the spec, as After does with "added operator step".

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moved f1, f2 and f4 by replacing Before's sentence "The pull-request description must carry this cutover instruction..." with the instruction itself, labelled as an operator step: "Before merging, a repository admin creates the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret." That keeps the repository admin and the before-merge timing and drops the "must carry" obligation on the implementation. f3 holds in both: the audit keeps Applied:/Deferred:/Rejected: with one disposition, and [major] and raised-by: [alpha-core] copied from the chair. The one fragile spot is the residual parenthetical "(for the pull-request description)" in the spec, echoed as "for the pull-request description" in the audit's Applied line. It is a label rather than an obligation, so f2 holds, but a stricter reader could take it as an implied PR-body deliverable. To make f2 robust, the wording should tell the model to drop the delivery vehicle entirely and write only something like "Operator step: Before merging, a repository admin creates the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret.", and to describe the application in the audit without naming the PR description as the destination. After also added "No feature docs are introduced or amended." to Documentation impact; this touches no fact here, but if it is not intended, the wording should confine the edit to the targeted section.
